description: Natural Earth 1:10m world background and country outlines. Shared polygon arcs are stored once, including microstates and dependencies. Countries without an atlas page remain light gray and noninteractive. Atlas maps and their established frontier layers retain priority.
license: Natural Earth: public domain. Atlas-aligned derivatives retain the licenses listed in sources.atlas, including OpenStreetMap ODbL 1.0 and national open-data terms.

topology.policy: Atlas display outlines are fixed references; foreign survey overlaps are clipped, and uncovered old-reference land within an 8 km land-frontier corridor is assigned to the nearest foreign edge. Source lake polygons are excluded. This reconciles display geometry and does not redefine sovereignty or claims.

delegatedOutlineCodes.KAS: Existing India/Pakistan/China atlas outlines cover this inland disputed source entity; its residual background fill is retained without false coastline strokes.
delegatedOutlineCodes.LIE: Landlocked Liechtenstein is fully surrounded by the Austrian and Swiss atlas frontiers. Its gray land remains; those shared atlas edges supply the complete outline.

delegatedAreas.KAB: The Baykonur Cosmodrome source area is already inside the Kazakhstan atlas silhouette.
delegatedAreas.BRI: The Brazilian Island source area is already covered by the Brazil/Uruguay display and its existing claim handling.
delegatedAreas.SPI: The Southern Patagonian Ice Field source area is already covered by Chile/Argentina and their existing claim handling.

topology.fourEurope: Detailed new-country land frontiers supersede residual generalized shoreline segments within 200 metres. Existing atlas borders are retained.
topology.balkans: Detailed Balkan land frontiers supersede residual generalized shoreline segments within 200 metres. Existing atlas borders are retained; Croatia–Montenegro stops at the verified shared-way coastal endpoint.
topology.balkanFallbackRefresh: Country fallback land refreshed from the six final reconciled contexts, preserving all other atlas and foreign geometry.

titicacaShoreline.detail: Coarse copy for the world fallback only; country fills retain full mapped shoreline

pakistanWater.method: Mangla and Tarbela reservoir holes are retained in the coarse background, as in the country land fills.

kyrgyzstanWater.license: Natural Earth public domain; © OpenStreetMap contributors ODbL1.0
kyrgyzstanWater.method: Issyk-Kul, Song-Kul, Chatyr-Kul and Toktogul Reservoir are cut out of fallback land as well as the detailed map.

myanmarLaosWater.license: Natural Earth public domain; © OpenStreetMap contributors ODbL 1.0
myanmarLaosWater.method: Lake water excluded from detailed country land is also cut from fallback world land.

himalayaCountryShapes.method: Coarse fallback is omitted for these three supported countries; their existing detailed portal sources provide reconciled land and mapped Kaptai Lake holes. Avoids duplicate land, shoreline protrusions and extra world-background download weight.

balticWater.method: Complete Peipus–Lämmijärv–Pskov lake system and Curonian Lagoon excluded from land fills. Detailed mapped shoreline compared with Esri World Imagery; district boundary strokes remain independent.

polandBoundarySliver.method: One pinned triangular overlay hole in verified forest/farmland is filled; actual lake rings are preserved.

khankaWater.method: Full satellite-checked Lake Khanka shoreline is excluded from permanent land independently of the optional major-water overlay.

polandWater.method: Mapped cross-border lagoons and official PRG Gulf of Gdańsk / Puck Bay water are excluded from land fills.

usMexicoReconciliation.method: One complete US county-derived exterior is the shared display edge. Mexican border municipalities follow it, and their parent states are dissolved from those same leaves. The US-owned stroke, both fallback silhouettes and country previews use that edge. All other international frontiers and inland subdivision edges are retained; coastal endpoint adjustments are limited to one kilometre.

centralAmericaIntegration.method: Replace only the former Costa Rica and Panama gray silhouettes; align the adjacent Nicaraguan edge to Costa Rica. Existing interactive country fallbacks retain their exact geometry.

joins.method: direct polygon overlay at a lake-separated or differently defined source endpoint
joins.sourceDifference: Reference endpoints do not meet the country outline

joins.method: direct polygon overlay at a lake-separated or differently defined source endpoint
joins.sourceDifference: Reference endpoints do not meet the country outline

eastSouthAfricaIntegration.method: Replace the four former gray silhouettes; join adjacent foreign land to the new country frontiers, remove lake surfaces, and derive shared background strokes from the resulting geometry.

moldovaCentralAsiaIntegration.method: Replace the four former gray silhouettes; join adjacent foreign land to the new country frontiers, remove lake surfaces, and derive shared background strokes from the resulting geometry.

caucasusGulfIntegration.method: Replace the six former gray silhouettes; join adjacent foreign land to the new country frontiers, remove lake surfaces, and derive shared background strokes from the resulting geometry.

antarctica.policy: One continent in shared backgrounds; territorial sectors are visible only when their claimant country is open.

moldovaRomaniaReconciliation.method: Moldovan district exteriors and context share the complete Romania-owned Prut arc; Romania supplies the single border stroke. Lake surfaces remain excluded.

westAsiaIntegration.method: Replace the three former gray silhouettes; join adjacent foreign land to the new country frontiers, remove lake surfaces, and derive shared background strokes from the resulting geometry.

khorAlAdaidCorrection.method: Replace the two country silhouettes together using their reconciled land geometry; coastal and maritime arcs have no stroke.

melanesiaIntegration.method: Replace only the three former background silhouettes. PNG owns the land-only New Guinea frontier once; no coast or maritime strokes. Existing country geometries, including local coast repairs, are preserved.

arabiaLevantIntegration.method: Replace the four former background silhouettes; align existing neighbours and draw each shared land frontier once. Existing interactive geometry and local coast repairs are preserved.

caribbeanIntegration.method: Replace only the five former background silhouettes and their obsolete coast/frontier groups. Haiti owns the single land-only Hispaniola frontier; no coast or maritime strokes are added. Existing interactive geometry and all atlas frontier bytes are preserved.

indianOceanIntegration.method: Replace the four former background silhouettes; align existing neighbours and draw each shared land frontier once. Existing interactive geometry and local coast repairs are preserved.

hornIslandsIntegration.method: Replace the six former gray silhouettes, including Somaliland within Somalia; join adjacent foreign land to the new country frontiers, remove lake surfaces, and derive shared background strokes from the resulting geometry.

coastalOceaniaIntegration.method: Replace the remaining coastal African and Pacific background silhouettes; join adjacent foreign land to the new country frontiers, remove lake surfaces, and derive shared background strokes from the resulting geometry.

canadaLakes.method: Permanent lake exclusions matching Canadian administrative fills.
